title: A customer replies with a “diagnostic file”
scenario: A long-term enterprise customer replies in an existing support ticket with a ZIP file they say contains logs. They apologize for the size and ask you to run a small viewer included in the archive.

answers.A: Run it because the customer is trusted and the file is inside a real support ticket.
answers.B: Use approved malware-scanning/sandbox and support procedures; do not run customer-provided executables on your workstation.
answers.C: Ask the customer to provide logs in a safe text/export format through the support portal.

explanation: Trusted customers can be compromised, and legitimate support context is useful cover for malware.
proTip: Trust the customer relationship; distrust executable attachments.
